patients.subtitle: Search by mobile, name, hospital number or order code.
patients.searchPlaceholder: Mobile, name, hospital no. or order code…
patients.registerHint: We check for an existing record with the same mobile or a similar name first.
patients.duplicateHint: Check whether one of these is the same person before creating a new record.
patients.mobileHint: SMS with the code goes to this number.
patients.noMatch: No patient found. Register them instead.
patients.pickHint: Search on the left to see their details and orders.

helpdesk.subtitle: Find or register the patient, select tests while looking at the paper prescription, then print the 3-part slip.
helpdesk.step2Hint: Optional photo of the paper prescription (webcam or phone).
helpdesk.step3Hint: Verify inline: select exactly what the prescription asks for.
helpdesk.photoHint: Up to 3 pages; compressed to 1 MB each.
helpdesk.waiverHint: A waiver approver must approve this before the order is free or discounted.
helpdesk.inlineNote: Creating the order records you as the verifier. The order goes straight to “Awaiting payment”.
helpdesk.waiverPending: A waiver request is waiting for approval. The patient pays only what remains after the decision.
helpdesk.nextBank: Send the patient to the bank booth with the slip. After payment the token is issued there.

verify.queueSubtitle: Online requests, oldest deadline first. Rows turn red when the SLA is missed.
verify.emptyBody: New online requests appear here automatically.
verify.testsHint: Compare with the prescription; add or remove tests as written.
verify.edited: You changed the tests. The patient will see the corrected list and price.
verify.clarifyHint: Say exactly what is missing (e.g. a clearer photo of page 2).
verify.rejectHint: The patient is told by SMS. They can visit the help desk.
verify.smsNote: The patient gets an SMS and sees this text in the app.
verify.notPending: This order is not waiting for verification any more.
verify.confirmed: Verified — the patient has been told the amount

waivers.subtitle: Emergency, free, poor fund and staff concession requests. Every decision is audited.
waivers.discountHint: Order total {{total}}. Enter the full total to make it free.
waivers.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log with your name.

orders.subtitle: Every order from every channel.
orders.searchPlaceholder: Order code, mobile or patient name…

catalog.subtitle: Tests, aliases for search, prices with history, departments.
catalog.priceHint: A change starts a new price period; existing orders keep their price.
catalog.aliasesHint: Separate with | — e.g. S. Creat | Creatinine | ক্রিয়েটিনিন
catalog.importHint: Upload the BMU-confirmed CSV files. Importing the same file twice changes nothing.

importKinds.tests: tests, aliases, specimen, container, fasting, prep, TAT, price

admin.subtitle: Accounts, roles and two-step verification.
admin.usernameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dot or underscore.
admin.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. They must change it at first login.
admin.totpReset: Two-step reset — they enrol again at next login
